_comment: Copy to config.local.json (git-ignored) and keep only the keys you need. Environment variables (EDIABAS_VM_NAME, EDIABAS_VM_MAC, EDIABAS_AGENT_PORT) win over this file. vmName is the VM's name in UTM (default Windows); its MAC is read from UTM's config for that VM. Add "vmMac": "aa:bb:cc:dd:ee:ff" only if that lookup fails. voltageSources: extra voltage readings for ediabas_vehicle_status, as {"ecu": ..., "job": ...} entries (at most 16), e.g. {"ecu": "NVE_65", "job": "STATUS_BORDNETZSPANNUNG"} on an E60/E61 with night vision; none by default. Keys starting with _ are comments. backend: vm (default) or native; native runs the ediabas_* tools through ediabasd on this Mac (EDIABAS_BACKEND wins), with no vm_* tools and bridge_health in place of vm_health. ediabasdPath: the ediabasd executable (EDIABASD_PATH wins; default this repo's engine/ediabasd-net/bin/Release/net10.0/ediabasd). ediabasdConfig: passed to ediabasd as --config (default its own ~/.config/bimmer-bridge/config.json). dotnetRoot: passed to ediabasd as DOTNET_ROOT, e.g. /opt/homebrew/opt/dotnet@10/libexec.
